overall_conclusion: Original screenshots and sampled video support target-specific Command draft close confirmation for inactive A while S stays selected, and retention of A after the operator-recorded Cancel. Later S retention has separate still evidence. This run is not a complete D2-T11/T14 acceptance and the video does not cover the whole app run.

video.recorder_exit_interpretation: File finalized; it is not a successful complete recording of the app run.
video.size_note: The finish event recorded a smaller in-progress size than the final 20104684-byte file. This review identifies the final artifact by its actual SHA256/size; it does not infer a cause for the size difference or the stream stop.
video.sampling_description: Viewed all 9 overview sheets (first source frame at/after every 3 seconds plus final frame) and all 6 detail sheets. Detail intervals: 118–124s every 0.5s; 134–139s every 0.25s; 141–145s every 0.5s; 218–226s every 0.5s; six key timestamps. Four full-window detail files were also viewed individually. Exact source-frame indices and PTS are saved. No synthetic/interpolated frames.
video.wall_clock_note: PTS is the authoritative media timestamp. Adding PTS to recording_started gives only an approximate wall-clock correspondence; no claim of zero capture pipeline latency.

source_separation.raw_evidence: Six original PNGs and their timestamp/window/process-subtree JSONs; original MP4; recording.log; launch.log.
source_separation.operator_record: operator-observations.json explicitly says reconstructed from actual CUA tool responses. It is not a raw AX export, controller trace, event/byte trace, or independently timestamped log of every action.
source_separation.process_identity: A 77921/ttys008 and S 81098/ttys017 agree between visible printf output and sampled OS process-subtree sidecars. B 80398/ttys016 and extra 87622/ttys018 are in OS metadata. This establishes identities at sampled instants, not absence of all transient/hidden PTYs.
source_separation.b_ai_draft: Exact B AI draft is reported by operator-observations.json. The six original stills and selected video frames reviewed here do not independently show that exact B draft; the individual PTS75.003333 frame is the empty AI workspace before drafting.
source_separation.counter: exists_at_end:false is a recorded observation for the deliberately prepared fixture-side effect marker c10-unexpected-command.log. It does not prove PTY zero writes, no commands of any kind, request counts, or no network traffic. This reviewer did not inspect user/production storage.
source_separation.model: No model configured/submitted is an operator/setup assertion; no network capture is present. This is not real-model/API acceptance.
source_separation.keyboard: CUA-mediated normal UI interactions, not controller injection according to operator/setup record. Do not relabel these as measured physical hardware keyboard events.
source_separation.accessibility: launch.log contains ten Failed to update ui::AXTree messages and Application finished. Later PNGs alone do not prove stale/minimal AX. No causal link between AX failures and ScreenCaptureKit -3822 is established.
source_separation.foreground: Per-still sidecars show foreground app for baseline/three-tabs/confirmation/A-after. The later survivor/final captures are inactive. No whole-run foreground assertion.

supported_partial_findings: Inactive A is the only target shown in its Command draft close confirmation while S remains selected behind it.
The operator-recorded Cancel is corroborated by modal dismissal, three retained tabs, and the exact A draft on subsequent video samples and an original screenshot.
S exact draft is visible before the close attempt and in a later original screenshot; the latter is outside the video.
A and S visible PID/TTY outputs agree with the retained shell identities at sampled OS checkpoints.
not_established: Native first-primary mouse reporting, inactive-secondary TUI bytes, or focus-in/focus-out protocol correctness in this run.
Idle AI close, old-task/source-only protection, barrier-click cancel, final explicit close.
Video-proven Escape key delivery; later survivor/final state inside the video; complete foreground app run.
Zero PTY writes or network requests from absence of the prepared marker file.
Unchanged original A draft at the final screenshot: the intentional suffix must be acknowledged.
wording_to_avoid: Do not describe recording_exit_code=0 as a complete successful recording. The stream ended with -3822 and whole-run coverage is false.
Do not call operator-observations.json a raw AX dump or continuous controller/PTY trace.
Do not call the later survivor/final screenshots video checkpoints, or call every capture foreground.
Do not treat counter absence as zero-write proof or upgrade this partial run to formal D2 passed.
Do not claim the final PNG itself demonstrates AX tree failure; cite launch.log/operator observations for that separate failure.

privacy_and_archive.visible_media_result: No real model API key, SSH private key, production host/profile, or personal message was seen in the six viewed originals or the 157 sampled source frames. Visible content is fixture commands, test paths, PID/TTY and app UI. This is bounded sampling, not all-frame/all-pixel privacy certification.
privacy_and_archive.text_metadata: Raw launch.log contains the local username/project paths and an ephemeral loopback Dart VM Service/DevTools URL with an authentication path. The app had exited, so this review does not claim a live external credential exposure. For public publication use a clearly labeled sanitized derivative of that text, preserving the raw original/hash locally; do not silently rewrite the original.
privacy_and_archive.archivable_video: native-window.mp4, with explicit partial-duration/SCStream error limits and original SHA256.
privacy_and_archive.raw_launch_log: Preserve original and hash; publish sanitized text if removing local debug URL/path data.
privacy_and_archive.derived_artifacts: review/ contact sheets and frame PNGs are derived review aids, never substitutes for original native checkpoints.
